name: next-steps-askcard
description: As each turn ends, suggests up to three next prompts in the question card. Pick one (or type your own) and it lands in the input box as a draft you can edit. The turn waits for the card, so it ends once you answer or close it.

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest answer to suggest after
minAnswerChars.description: Skip suggestions after answers shorter than this many characters.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest skills and slash commands
suggestSkills.description: Tell the suggester which skills and slash commands this session has, so a suggestion can be one of them.

startCollapsed.title: Start collapsed
startCollapsed.description: Applies to the card drawn above the input where the question card cannot be raised: show only its title row until you expand it. Once you expand or collapse a card, the session keeps your choice.
